prompt:
The image shows a zebra-striped table with one Name column, several numeric columns, alternating row shading, and a shaded header row. Find the row that wins the requested source-column extremum, then read the requested target-column value from that same row. Look for the maximum Time row and report its Rate value.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence format: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly two bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] with the decisive source extremum cell first and the transferred target value cell second.
Answer requirement: set "answer" to the exact integer value from the transferred target cell.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236]],"answer":19}
